_comment: Canonical schema for the in-app update check (Phase 24 / R-209). The operator uploads the LIVE copy to Supabase Storage (public bucket, e.g. app-release/android/latest.json); this checked-in example is the source-of-truth schema (Principle II/XII). The app reads it on cold start and compares semver-first (build number tiebreaker). A missing/unreachable/malformed object is a silent no-op (FR-010).
